verse.verse_1: Read! In the Name of your Lord, Who has created (all that exists),
verse.verse_2: Has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood).
verse.verse_3: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,
verse.verse_4: Who has taught (the writing) by the pen [the first person to write was Prophet Idrees (Enoch)].
verse.verse_5: Has taught man that which he knew not.
verse.verse_6: Nay! Verily, man does transgress all bounds (in disbelief and evil deed, etc.).
verse.verse_8: Surely! Unto your Lord is the return.
verse.verse_9: Have you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) seen him (i.e. Abu Jahl) who prevents,
verse.verse_10: A slave (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) when he prays?
verse.verse_11: Tell me, if he (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) is on the guidance (of Allah)?
verse.verse_13: Tell me if he (the disbeliever, Abu Jahl) denies (the truth, i.e. this Quran), and turns away?
verse.verse_14: Knows he not that Allah does see (what he does)?
verse.verse_15: Nay! If he (Abu Jahl) ceases not, We will catch him by the forelock,
verse.verse_17: Then, let him call upon his council (of helpers),
verse.verse_18: We will call the guards of Hell (to deal with him)!
verse.verse_19: Nay! (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him))! Do not obey him (Abu Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allah!
